534                         SANSKRIT GRAMMAR.                  [ § 966-968

(c) Sometimes it is used as an expletive; भीतः पार्थस्तथैव च.

(d) Sometimes it is used to connect a subordinate fact with a main one भिक्षामट या चानय wander for alms and bring a cow; कुट्टिनी च शासिता गोपी च निःसारिता कंदर्पकेतुश्च उरस्कृतः the procuress was chastised, the cowherdess was expelled and Kandarpaketu was honoured.

(e) When the particle is repeated it has sometimes the sense of 'on the one hand,' 'on the other hand,' 'and yet;' क च हरिणकानां जीवितं चातिकोलं क च निशितनिपाता वज्रसाराः शरास्ते where, on the one hand, is the extremely frail life of fawns, and where, on the other, are thy arrows hard like adamant and falling sharply; न सुलभा सकलेन्दुमुखी च सा किमपि चेदननक्रविचेष्टितम् । on the one hand the full moon-faced lady is not easy to obtain and yet there is this unaccountable sport of love.

(f) Sometimes the repetition of च shows the simultaneous or undelayed occurrence of two events; ते च प्रापुरुदन्वन्तं बुबुधे चादिपुरुषः they reached the ocean and at the same time the primeval Being also awoke.

§ 967. तथा 'likewise' often supplies the place of च; रामस्तथा लक्ष्मणश्च Rāma and Lakshmana; अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिस्तथा both Anāgatavidhāta and Pratyutpannamati; तथा हि means 'for instance, to be more plain;' तथा च 'likewise:' both are often used introducing quotations.

§ 968. तु but, हि for, because, and वा are also excluded from the first place in a sentence. आत्मा पुत्रः सखा भार्या दुहिता तु हृदितं किल the son is one's own self, the wife one's friend, but the daughter a source of anxiety; अथ्वात्मया शान्तिपुरात्मना वा प्राप्तोसि संभावितुं वनात्मनः । कालो ह्वयं संकलितुं द्वितीयं सभापकारप्रसमाभवं ते ।
